gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Comic Relief heads it with commanding strokes that look alike going up or sideways, so the serif text beneath feels all the more composed.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-pridi: Comic Relief draws with the steady line of a technical drafting pen, bold and commanding, with bowls left open on one side. Pridi, a text serif, counters with small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-scope-one: Loud and unfussy, Comic Relief leaves its bowls unfinished on one side and draws up and side strokes alike. And Scope One, a classic serif with stubby ascenders, lets the heading earn its keep when big and short.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-slabo-13px: Comic Relief draws bold, commanding letters with a wire-like line quality and bowls left unfinished on one side. Slabo 13px, a classic serif, brings bookish dignity and clear openings.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified is how Suwannaphum comes across, with a squared-off, woodblock-high x-height. Under Comic Relief's bold display letters, paragraph after paragraph of the classic serif reads editorial, its c as open as a bent paperclip.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-familjen-grotesk: Coming Soon writes casually, like a quick personal note in pen. Familjen Grotesk is lively, its lowercase rising tall, so extended text keeps moving, though brief bursts suit it best.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-hind: Coming Soon scrawls casual, personal letters, each o a ring with a constant wall. But Hind's string-taut strokes and c ends that never turn inward keep paragraphs comfortable, though brief spells suit it best.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-hoover: Hoover, refined and robust, gives the e's eye a generous entry and keeps its ascenders compressed. And beside Coming Soon's casual, unmodulated hand, the text serif settles into a paragraph easily, though brief reading is its home.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-technor: Technor reads cool and geometric, like neon tubing with a wide channel into every bowl. Technor's glowing, uniform line against Coming Soon's casual handwriting is the sharpest thing here, pleasant when kept brief.
gen-gf-corben-fs-rowan: Literary and friendly, Rowan is a serif with generous openings in every curve and thin strokes about half the thick ones. Corben makes the bold, distinctive statement; Rowan carries the brief reading.
